redirect_uris.description: Exact callbacks must form either an entirely localhost/loopback set or an entirely remote HTTPS set. HTTP is allowed only for localhost or literal loopback IPs. Local and remote callbacks cannot be mixed; user information and fragments are forbidden.

token_endpoint_auth_method.x-enum-exempt: RFC 7591 defines case-sensitive OAuth token endpoint authentication method identifiers.

items.x-enum-exempt: RFC 6749 and RFC 7591 define case-sensitive OAuth grant type identifiers.
RFC 6749 and RFC 7591 define case-sensitive OAuth response type identifiers.
